title: OpenAI And Anthropic Are Scaling Sales Teams Into A Market Where Nobody Has To Actually Sell
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are expanding rapidly in the AI market, with OpenAI scaling its sales team from 10 to 500 and targeting significant revenue growth. However, this growth comes with challenges as the intense demand may mask the actual sales skills of the team members.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights the risk of mediocre salespeople being promoted due to the high demand and inbound interest, potentially leading to a weakened sales force in the long term.
